description: This file defines a Text interface class and related enumerations for accessible text content, including methods for text manipulation, attribute retrieval, and bounding box calculations, used in accessibility tools.

classes.name: TEXT_BOUNDARY_TYPE
classes.description: Enumeration for different types of text boundaries, such as character, word, sentence, and line boundaries.

classes.name: TEXT_CLIP_TYPE
classes.description: Enumeration for different clipping modes when retrieving text ranges.

classes.name: TEXT_GRANULARITY_TYPE
classes.description: Enumeration for text granularity levels, including character, word, sentence, line, and paragraph.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: An accessibility interface class representing textual content, providing methods for text manipulation, attribute access, and spatial queries.

methods.name: addSelection
methods.description: Adds a text selection between startOffset and endOffset.

methods.name: getAttributeRun
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute run at a specific offset, including default attributes if specified.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a named attribute at a specific offset.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Deprecated method to get attributes at a specific offset as a string.

methods.name: getBoundedRanges
methods.description: Returns text ranges within a specified bounding box.

methods.name: getCharacterAtOffset
methods.description: Returns the Unicode code point at a given text offset.

methods.name: getCharacterExtents
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of a character at a specific offset.

methods.name: getDefaultAttributeSet
methods.description: Returns default text attributes for the entire object.

methods.name: getDefaultAttributes
methods.description: Deprecated method to get default attributes as a string.

methods.name: getNSelections
methods.description: Returns the number of selections.

methods.name: getOffsetAtPoint
methods.description: Returns the text offset at a specific screen coordinate.

methods.name: getRangeExtents
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of a text range.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Retrieves the start and end offsets of a selection.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content between startOffset and endOffset.

methods.name: getTextAfterOffset
methods.description: Returns text following a specific offset, delimited by boundary type.

methods.name: getTextAtOffset
methods.description: Returns text at a specific offset, delimited by boundary type.

methods.name: getTextBeforeOffset
methods.description: Returns text preceding a specific offset, delimited by boundary type.

methods.name: getStringAtOffset
methods.description: Returns text at a specific offset, delimited by granularity.

methods.name: removeSelection
methods.description: Removes a specific selection.

methods.name: setCaretOffset
methods.description: Moves the caret to a specific offset.

methods.name: setSelection
methods.description: Modifies an existing selection's start and end offsets.

methods.name: get_caretOffset
methods.description: Property getter for current caret offset.

methods.name: get_characterCount
methods.description: Property getter for total character count.

methods.name: scrollSubstringTo
methods.description: Scrolls to make a text range visible.

methods.name: scrollSubstringToPoint
methods.description: Scrolls to make a text range visible at a specific point.
